Phase.Goal: Build a modular User Manager application with auth and logging.

Wave.Goal: Create the User model and a simple in-memory database to store users. Must include password hashing simulation.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: database.py contains a User dataclass/class and a Database class.
Database supports add_user and get_user methods.

Wave.Goal: Develop authentication and logging modules in parallel.

Slice.Goal: Create auth.py providing register and login functions using the database from WAVE-DB-1.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: register function creates a user, login validates credentials.

Slice.Goal: Create logger.py providing a simple audit logger that writes to stdout/memory.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: logger.py provides a Logger class with a log(message) method.

Wave.Goal: Integrate all modules into a main application entry point and write an end-to-end test.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: app.py imports database, auth, and logger.
End-to-end test registers a user, logs them in, and checks audit logs.

DeferredWork.Item: Add REST API endpoints in a future phase.
